description_en: Provides methods and steps to obtain a HTTP link for accessing a container
description_zh: 提供获取容器访问HTTP链接的方法和步骤
kebab_example: aliyun pai-dlc get-web-terminal --job-id dlc-20210126170216-000000 --pod-id dlc-20210126170216-0000-chief-0 --pod-uid 94a7cc7c-0033-48b5-85bd-71c63592c268 --is-shared true --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetWebTerminal

parameters.help_en: The ID of the pod in the task
parameters.name: pod_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to create a shareable link to access the container. Valid values:

true: returns a shareable link to access the container. The link will expire after 30 seconds and can only be used once. After you access the container by using the link, other requests that use this link to access the container become invalid.
false: returns a common shareable link to access the container. If you use a common shareable link to access a container, Alibaba Cloud identity authentication is required. The link will expire after 30 seconds
parameters.help_zh:
是否创建用于分享的进入容器链接，取值如下：
true：返回进入容器的分享链接。该链接将在三十秒后失效，且仅能被使用一次。一旦通过该链接进入容器后，其他使用该链接进入容器的请求将无效。
false：返回普通的进入容器的分享链接，使用时需进行阿里云身份认证。该链接将在三十秒后失效
parameters.name: is_shared

RequestId.description_en: The request ID which is used for diagnostics and Q\&A
RequestId.description_zh: 此次调用的请求ID，用于诊断和答疑
